chk_problem.label: accurate
chk_problem.poster_evidence: Per-frame detector passes dominate edge cost, and blind skipping breaks accuracy on BDD100K MOT dashcam video.

chk_method.label: accurate
chk_method.poster_evidence: ALBIREO is a detector-agnostic, codec-free wrapper that decides when detector calls can be skipped. It keeps a 10-dimensional Kalman filter per object and invokes the detector only when uncertainty exceeds a threshold. Skipped frames get predicted boxes at near-zero GPU cost, with a rescue mechanism and an empty-scene screen. No retraining needed.
chk_method.reason: The poster accurately describes ALBIREO as a detector-agnostic, codec-free adaptive inference framework using Kalman filter uncertainty, rescue mechanisms, and empty-scene screening.
